setup.title: {guild_name} • Server Control Center

Use the category selection menu and buttons below to manage modules in real-time.

setup.select_log_channel: Select text or forum channel for logs...
setup.unauthorized: ❌ Only administrators can interact with this setup dashboard.

User: {user} (`{user_id}`)

**Global command lockdown has been {status_lower}!**
```diff
{sign} EMERGENCY LOCKDOWN PROTOCOL {status}
```

**Commands are currently locked down server-wide.**
The bot is in emergency maintenance mode. Please try again later or contact the owner.

errors.user_not_found: The specified user was not found on this server.
errors.guild_only: This command can only be used within a server.

honeypot.embed_desc:
⚠️ **DO NOT TYPE OR SEND ANY MESSAGES HERE!**

Any account that sends a message in this channel will be **automatically banned for 3 days**.

• This channel is exclusively monitored to catch automated spam bots, webhooks, and compromised accounts.
• Normal users: please mute or hide this channel.
honeypot.embed_footer: Automated Security Trap • 3-Day Ban on Message
honeypot.setup_success:
Honeypot channel has been set to {channel}.
A permanent warning notice has been posted.
honeypot.setup_created: Honeypot channel {channel} has been successfully created and secured.
honeypot.remove_success: Honeypot protection has been disabled on this server.
honeypot.not_active: Honeypot protection is not active on this server.
honeypot.dm_banned_desc:
You sent a message in the Honeypot trap channel on **{guild_name}**.
As warned, your account has been **temporarily banned for 3 days**.

**Ban Expiration:** {unban_time}
**Reason:** Automated Spam / Compromised Account Trap
honeypot.log_desc:
User {user} (`{user_id}`) posted in {channel} and was banned for 3 days.

**Message Preview:**
```{content}```
**Unban Scheduled:** {unban_time}
